# Project Guide

Contributor and agent guidance for this repository.

## Setup

Install with `pip install -e .`. Run tests with `pytest`.

## Naming (MANDATORY)

Whenever this project renders a person's name as a single string, it MUST be formatted as
`LAST, FIRST` — the LAST name, then a comma and a single space, then the FIRST name. It is
NEVER rendered as `First Last`. For example, first="Grace", last="Hopper" renders as
`Hopper, Grace`. Every function that produces a full-name string MUST follow this format.

## Testing

Tests live under `tests/`. All new code needs a test.
